author: Numberz_
body:
Heyy, guys! Lately I've been playing around building maps. And I decided to make a TDM one which I'm happy with the results c;


Author: 99250
Images: http://imgur.com/a/fur7c
YAML/XML: None atm (might need help xD)
Download: None yet.

Features:
-No sides on edges (allowing people to be knocked into the void).
-Lots of arrow spawners (along the sides)
-Gapple spawners
-Two scoreboxes (one on each side of spawn)

Hope you guys like it! :D Feedback is appreciated!

replies.author: tomqss
replies.body: It is too flat in my opinion, and the scoreboxes are too near from the spawn, which will make scoring almost impossible.
replies.body_tagged: It is too flat in my opinion, and the scoreboxes are too near from the spawn, which will make scoring almost impossible.

replies.author: Numberz_
replies.body:
Thanks for your feedback!

"It is too flat in my opinion"-
Parts of the map decrease a few blocks (mid for example) which doesn't make the map completely flat. Personally, I enjoy it when maps have a lot of flat spots, makes it easier to PvP.

"the scoreboxes are too near from the spawn, which will make scoring almost impossible"-
It takes about 10-12 seconds from the time you spawn until you get to the stairs, which IMO is enough  time for players to get into the scoreboxes (which takes about 5 seconds to get through the cobwebs).

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body: I think there should be more/better cover. If one team controls the middle spawners, it looks fairly hard to retake control, since any sort of push will have to run through a lot of open ground. The map also seems a bit constricting, width wise. I'm ok with that, but others may find it annoying.

replies.author: Numberz_
replies.body:
Alrighty, so I've taken some of the advice that was actually helpful on this topic along with some help from Flat (Sli) and made some changes.

-Added- a tunnel system along the sides to the map that allows more options when rushing towards the scoreboxes
-Added- cobwebs to spawn, making the timer a bit longer
-Added- more protection along the sides of the map so you can't get hit with arrows so easily
-Added- more levels to the map
-Removed- some arrow spawners
-Removed- steps near spawn

On top of all that I've also made the map a bit shorter distance wise (recommended by Sli).

Updated Images: https://imgur.com/a/tiF3b

Map Overview-
Red= Scoreboxes
Gray= Arrow spawners
Orange= tunnels
Yellow= Gapple spawner
